Live/1975–85 (discs made in Japan)

~ Release by Bruce Springsteen & The E Street Band (see all versions of this release, 130 available)

Annotation

12x12‐inch cardboard box set with booklet inside. The boxset has “Printed in Germany” and the discs have “Manufactured by CBS/Sony Inc. in Japan”.

Mixed and assembled at Right Track Recording on Sony Digital 2‐Track Equipment; Titles from 1984–85 recorded on Sony Digital 24‐Track.

Printed on back of the box:
℗ 1984*, 1986 Bruce Springsteen/ © 1986 Bruce Springsteen/CBS and logo, ® CBS Inc./Printed in Germany/Imprimé en Allemagne/Distribution CBS Records/CBS Disques S.A. WARNING: All rights of the producer and of the owner of the recorded work reserved. Unauthorized copying, public performance, broadcasting, hiring or rental of this recording prohibited. In the UK apply for public performance licences to PPL, 14/22 Ganton Street, London W1.
‐‐‐‐‐‐‐‐‐‐‐‐‐‐‐‐‐‐‐‐‐‐‐‐‐‐‐‐‐‐‐‐‐‐‐‐‐‐‐‐‐‐‐‐

Track 3–13: ℗ 1984 Bruce Springsteen
All other tracks: ℗ 1986 Bruce Springsteen

Disc 1: DIDP 10594
Disc 2: DIPD 10595
Disc 3: DIPD 10596
Includes 36 page booklet.
